text: こどもが　こんな　くらい　ところを　ウロウロ　しちゃ　いかん　なあ

structure.jp: こんな　くらい　ところを
structure.en: around a dark place like this

structure.jp: ウロウロ　しちゃ　いかん　なあ
structure.en: shouldn't be wandering about, you know

patterns.name: 〜てはいけない
patterns.explanation: ては plus いけない means 'must not do'. Here ては is shortened to ちゃ and いけない becomes いかん, the way an older man talks. しちゃ　いかん = 'mustn't do'.

patterns.name: 〜を (through)
patterns.span: ところを　ウロウロ
patterns.explanation: With a moving-about word, を shows the place you move around in. ところを　ウロウロ = 'wandering around a place'.

patterns.name: 〜な (musing)
patterns.explanation: な at the end, stretched to なあ, is the speaker remarking on something with feeling. いかん　なあ = 'that won't do, you know'.
